schema.description:
Outcome of one retention pass, as returned by
`POST /b/tickets/api/admin/retention/prune`.

complete.description:
Whether every delete in the pass succeeded. A `false` here is answered
with HTTP 503 so a scheduler retries.

errors.description:
Names of the deletes that failed (`"analyses"`, `"events"`,
`"tickets"`, `"rate-counters"`).

tickets_deleted.description: Expired tickets removed. Tickets under legal hold never expire.

Whether an audit-timeline write has failed since the flag was last

last_prune_error.description:
Comma-joined names of the deletes that failed on the last pass, or `""`

security.description:

positive_limits.description: Whether both submission rate limits have a positive cap and window.

public_enabled.description: Whether the operator has turned public submissions on.

ready.description: Whether all of the checks below passed.

reasons.description:
Human-readable reason for each failed check, in check order. Empty when
`ready`.

site_key_configured.description: Whether a Turnstile widget site key is configured.

urgent_tickets.description: Tickets at `"urgent"` priority, in any state.

schema.title: TicketListResponse

schema.description:
Request body of `POST /b/tickets/api/admin/tickets`.

This is the internal intake path. It cannot file a public report: `source`
must be `"admin"`, `"api"` or `"ai"`, and the endpoint records no reporter
contact details — a ticket created here has an empty `reporter_email` and
no reply consent.

priority.description:
`"low"`, `"normal"`, `"high"` or `"urgent"`. Defaults to the ticket
type's own default priority.

source.description:
Origin to record: `"admin"`, `"api"` or `"ai"`. `"public_form"` is
rejected with 400.

source_path.description: Same-site path the ticket refers to. Must start with a single `/`.

subject_id.description: Id of the thing this is about (≤160 characters).

subject_type.description: Kind of the thing this is about (lowercase slug, ≤64 characters).

type_id.description: Id of an active ticket type.

schema.description: Identifier from the route, as returned by a list endpoint.

Request body of `PATCH /b/tickets/api/admin/tickets/{id}`.

Only workflow fields are mutable. The original report is immutable: no
field here can edit the subject, description, evidence URL or reporter
contact details.

Id of the ticket this one duplicates. Required when moving to
`"duplicate"`, and must name an existing, different ticket.

reason.description:
Why the change was made, ≤4000 characters. Required when closing a
ticket (`"resolved"`, `"rejected"`, `"spam"`, `"duplicate"`) and
recorded on the audit timeline with the change it explains. A reason
sent with no change is refused with 400: a comment is a note.

status.description:
New workflow state: `"new"`, `"triaged"`, `"investigating"`,
`"resolved"`, `"rejected"`, `"spam"` or `"duplicate"`. A closed ticket
can only reopen to `"triaged"`.
